blocks.text: Integrated medical and mental health services
Comprehensive Addiction & Dual Diagnosis Treatment Programs in Dallas, Texas

blocks.html: Addiction and mental health disorders affect millions of individuals and families across the United States each year. Behind every diagnosis is a person whose health, relationships, and daily life have been deeply impacted. According to the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA), more than 46 million Americans struggle with substance use disorders, including alcohol, opioids, benzodiazepines, cocaine, methamphetamine, and prescription drug addiction. At the same time, the National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) reports that nearly 1 in 5 U.S. adults experiences a mental health disorder annually, with conditions such as depression, anxiety, PTSD, and bipolar disorder frequently occurring alongside addiction.

blocks.html: Dallas Detox Center is committed to providing comprehensive addiction treatment and dual diagnosis care in a safe, medically supervised environment. Our programs are designed for individuals struggling with alcohol addiction, opioid dependence, benzodiazepine use, stimulant addiction, and co-occurring mental health disorders such as depression, anxiety, trauma-related conditions, and mood disorders. By integrating medical detox, residential stabilization, and structured mental health treatment, we ensure that both substance use and underlying psychological factors are addressed together.
